Unraid templates by tg099.
**Crossfade** keeps liked songs, libraries and playlists in sync across music streaming services: one way, both ways or in groups. Self-hosted, several people per instance.
Questions and bug reports: [Crossfade issues on GitHub](https://github.com/tg099/crossfade/issues). Problems with the template itself: [issues of this repository](https://github.com/tg099/unraid-templates/issues).
